But the advantage is that it helps kill the hivemind...
How does it help kill the hive mind?

Because the way Reddit does it, if you're expressing a view contrary to the majority view, you get double-whammied both by people upvoting the posts expressing views favorable to the majority and yours downvoted by the same people - which results in your post sinking to the bottom.

If you could only vote up, then the posts favored by a majority would still rise to the top, but hopefully your post would end up closer to the middle. People might still see it.

It also eliminates the possibility of "downvote brigades".
